integration-youtube-api-key-intro: Connecting YouTube requires a Google API key.
integration-youtube-api-key-step1: 1. Open <lnk>Google Cloud Console</lnk> and sign in to your Google account.
integration-youtube-api-key-step2: 2. Create a new project (or select an existing one): click SELECT PROJECT → New Project, enter a name and click CREATE.
integration-youtube-api-key-step3: 3. In the left menu, go to APIs & Services → Library. Find YouTube Data API v3 and click ENABLE.
integration-youtube-api-key-step4: 4. Go to APIs & Services → Credentials. Click CREATE CREDENTIALS → API key. Copy the generated key.
integration-youtube-api-key-step5: 5. Paste the copied key into the field below.
integration-youtube-handle-hint:
Enter the handle of your YouTube channel. It is the part of your channel URL after @, for example @MyChannel.

The handle will be used to automatically find your channel on YouTube.
